beats.what: Under interrogation beside a bagged phone, Lynn insists her exam result matches her real ability
Lynn's father pitches her prizes and grades to the school director while Lynn itemises the fees and argues the transfer is not worth the money
The director waives Lynn's tuition on condition she prove the school's investment, and Lynn enrols
Years on at ID photo day, Grace adopts Lynn as a friend, fixing her hair and taking off her glasses
Grace tells Lynn she needs a 3.25 to keep the lead in the school play and cannot pass maths even with tutors
Grace trades milk tea and homework for lessons, and Lynn agrees to coach her off an old exam paper
The maths midterm starts and Grace recognises every question from the practice sheet she studied with Lynn, but still cannot answer them
Grace sees the proctor buried in his phone and whispers back to Lynn for the answers
Lynn pencils the answer letters along the side of her eraser
Lynn drops the eraser into her shoe and kicks it out into the aisle toward Grace
Grace walks up to the proctor's desk as cover and the eraser is dug out of the shoe, letting her fill in her sheet
Grace's report card comes back at 3.87 and she thanks Lynn in the corridor
Grace brings Lynn to Pat's family hotel, where Pat throws a rooftop pool party with champagne
Pat admits he cannot pass and offers Lynn 3,000 baht a head for the answers, with five more buyers already lined up
